  • 方法详细资料

    • hasBlockState

      boolean hasBlockState()
      Returns whether the item has a block state currently attached to it. 返回该物品当前是否已附加方块状态。
      返回:
      whether a block state is already attached 是否已附加方块状态

    • getBlockState

      BlockState getBlockState()
      Returns the currently attached block state for this item or creates a new one if one doesn't exist. 返回该物品当前附加的方块状态，若不存在则创建一个新的。 The state is a copy, it must be set back (or to another item) with setBlockState(org.bukkit.block.BlockState) 该状态是一个副本，必须通过 setBlockState(org.bukkit.block.BlockState) 设置回去（或设置到另一个物品上）
      返回:
      the attached state or a new state 已附加的状态或新创建的状态

    • setBlockState

      void setBlockState(BlockState blockState)
      Attaches a copy of the passed block state to the item. 将传入方块状态的副本附加到该物品上。
      参数:
      blockState - the block state to attach to the block. 要附加到该物品上的方块状态。
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the blockState is null 若 blockState 为 null 或对该物品无效 or invalid for this item.
